writeup: Delta's Ashlyn two-handle centerset bathroom faucet in Stainless, model 2564-SSTP-DST, is $101.99 at Woot. Ferguson sells the same model for $189.90, so this is about 46% less. It uses Delta's Diamond Seal valve and fits a standard 3-hole, 4-inch centerset sink.
